Fix #329: muting Scene A or B (FUNC + SCENE A/B) now stops that scene's MIDI locks, as stock scene mute does for audio tracks. With one scene muted the crossfader morphs between the base value and the other scene. Muting the last scene sends the CC back to its base or trig-lock value, and the crossfader then leaves it unchanged.
Editing scene locks while holding a muted scene's key still works, as in stock.

A COMPRESSOR saved before the module was installed (on stock firmware) now comes up with its side-chain off: KEY OFF, KFLT and KGN centred, MON OFF. Stock firmware leaves 127/0/0/0 in the hidden page-2 slots, which 0.1.1 read as KEY "T127" with the key filter shut and the key gain at minimum, so the key barely reached the detector after KEY was turned down (Modwerk report #321).
A KEY already set to OFF or T1..T8 is never changed, so projects saved with 0.1.1 load as before. The check runs once per audio frame over the sixteen FX slots and never marks the Part as edited.

First release: the CUE CFG box, titled OUT CFG with the module, gains MATRIX, which makes the headphone jack a third assignable output beside MAIN and CUE. CUE + LEVEL picks each track's outputs (any combination of MAIN, CUE and PHONES, or one of six mono jacks); the routing lives in the Part. MIX becomes the PHONES level, and the metronome also plays on PHONES.
Switching to or from MATRIX converts every Part's LEVEL and cue bytes by documented rules, and switching into NORMAL also sets the project's cue settings.
